definitions.explanation: Describes something so extreme in its unpleasantness — pain, heat, noise, boredom, sadness — that one cannot endure it. The negative potential form of {耐|た}える (to endure).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐|た}えられない。
⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耐|た}えられなく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I could no longer bear the pain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無神経|むしんけい}→無神経：08472_mushinkei⟧な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐|た}えられなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't stand her insensitive words.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧な⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐|た}えられない。⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I can't take this boring meeting anymore. I wish it would end soon.

notes:
Negative potential form of ⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ (to endure; to bear). Functions as both a predicate ({耐|た}えられない) and a modifier ({耐|た}えられない⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧ — unbearable pain). Very common in everyday speech for expressing that something exceeds one's tolerance.

The subject of what is intolerable is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧:
- ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{耐|た}えられない: can't stand the heat
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐|た}えられない: can't bear this situation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐|た}えられない⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧: unbearable pain
- {耐|た}えられない⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧: unbearable heat
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{耐|た}えられない: I can't take it anymore
- {耐|た}えられないほど: to an unbearable degree

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}できない→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧: can't stand it — more colloquial, emphasizes the personal effort of trying to put up with something
- ⟦たまらない→たまらない：03409_tamaranai⟧: unbearable; irresistible — can be negative (unbearably bad) or positive (irresistibly good)
- ⟦{堪|こた}えられない→堪える：30446_kotaeru⟧: cannot endure — literary synonym using a different kanji
